_note: Candidate registry for Washington 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Washington Secretary of State, VoteWA Candidate List, GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026), Export to CSV (General Election candidates display after the Primary is certified; matches the Certification of Candidates to General Election dated August 21, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Washington Secretary of State, VoteWA Candidate List, GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026), Export to CSV (General Election candidates display after the Primary is certified; matches the Certification of Candidates to General Election dated August 21, 2026) (https://voter.votewa.gov/CandidateList.aspx?e=899); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
